pure-announcement.rationale: It is DAMA's own sales page with order links and 2nd-edition what's-new bullets, but it is not solely a launch note — the is/is-not sections describe the framework's role rather than announce a release.

duplicate.rationale: No nearest concept touches data-management frameworks; the closest matches are evals, vulnerability formats and MCP platform notes.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The central claim is that the DMBOK exists as a consensus reference with stated boundaries, which a reader can verify directly against the published book and DAMA's project pages.

durability.rationale: The DMBOK framework itself endures, but this page carries none of its content — only edition-specific marketing (2nd-edition bullets, 3.0 project status, order links) that the next revision cycle obsoletes.

actionability.rationale: The only action available to a reader is to order the book or pursue CDMP certification; the page conveys no data-management practice one could apply.

atomicity.rationale: Everything in the note is a facet of one statable idea — DMBOK is the consensus, non-prescriptive body of knowledge that defines the data-management profession's scope.
